sections.section_title:
Q.1 Choose the correct option/answer the following (Any seven question
                    only):

questions.text: Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
Which gas is primarily produced in a biogas plant?
Which of the following is an extensive property of a thermodynamic system?
Which of the following statements is TRUE about internal energy?
options: It depends on both temperature and molecular structure

questions.text: Which of the following represents a cyclic process?
options: The system returns to its initial state after the process

questions.text: In a vapour compression refrigeration cycle, the refrigerant absorbs heat in which component?
Which of the following is the main advantage of vapour absorption refrigeration over vapour compression refrigeration?
options: Uses mechanical energy instead of thermal energy
Can operate without electricity (uses thermal energy)

Describe biogas and biomass energy. Mention their merits, demerits, and major applications.
Explain the origin and forms of renewable energy sources such as solar and wind energy.
What are non-renewable or conventional sources of energy? Explain fossil fuels with examples.
Compare renewable and non-renewable energy sources in terms of availability, environmental impact, and sustainability.
Define a thermodynamic system. Explain its types with suitable examples.
Explain the concepts of state, process, and cycle in thermodynamics with diagrams.
Explain the principle of operation of a vapour compression refrigeration system with the help of a neat sketch.

Explain the working principle of a simple steam turbine with a neat sketch.
Compare SI (Spark Ignition) and CI (Compression Ignition) engines in terms of fuel used, ignition method, and applications.
Describe the main components and working of hydel power plant.
Discuss the principle of nuclear power generation. What are its advantages and disadvantages compared to thermal power plants?
Define ferrous and non-ferrous metals with examples.
Explain the mechanical properties of engineering materials such as strength, hardness, and resilience with suitable examples.
